# last-price-usage-and-billing: tool reference

<!-- Generated by scripts/sync.mjs from the live tools/list. Do not edit by hand. -->

Every tool below is on the Last Price MCP server (`https://api.last-price.ai/api/mcp/rpc?profile=directory`).
A tool missing from your own `tools/list` is not switched on for your connection yet.

## `get_usage`

Total your workspace's priced calls over a period, this calendar month by default: requests, units, compute time, cost, cached and prepaid calls, and the part of this month's cost still to be billed. Needs a Last Price credential. Needs a claimed workspace: a sandbox key from self-registration is refused (403) until a person claims the workspace.

- **Access:** key (claimed workspace only: a self-registered sandbox key gets 403)
- **Behaviour:** read-only

| Argument | Type | Meaning |
| :-- | :-- | :-- |
| `start_date` | string | Start of the period, ISO 8601. Defaults to the first of this month. |
| `end_date` | string | End of the period, ISO 8601. Defaults to now. |

## `get_usage_breakdown`

See your usage grouped by pricing function: calls, spend and outcomes for each function over a period. Pass start_date and end_date to choose the period, and group_by function, the only grouping there is. Read-only. Needs a Last Price credential. Needs a claimed workspace: a sandbox key from self-registration is refused (403) until a person claims the workspace.

- **Access:** key (claimed workspace only: a self-registered sandbox key gets 403)
- **Behaviour:** read-only

| Argument | Type | Meaning |
| :-- | :-- | :-- |
| `start_date` | string | The start of the period, as an ISO 8601 date and time. |
| `end_date` | string | The end of the period, as an ISO 8601 date and time. |
| `group_by` | `function` | How to group. Only function is available. |

## `list_usage_events`

List your workspace's priced calls, newest first: each one's id (what report_outcome takes to report it), function, cost, the price given and the inputs it was given for, and who sent it. Pass buyer_agent verified for only the calls whose buying agent proved who it was with an AgentID token. Needs a Last Price credential. Needs a claimed workspace: a sandbox key from self-registration is refused (403) until a person claims the workspace.

- **Access:** key (claimed workspace only: a self-registered sandbox key gets 403)
- **Behaviour:** read-only

| Argument | Type | Meaning |
| :-- | :-- | :-- |
| `function_id` | string | Only calls priced by this function. |
| `start_date` | string | Only calls from this time on, ISO 8601. |
| `end_date` | string | Only calls up to this time, ISO 8601. |
| `limit` | integer | Page size. Defaults to 50. |
| `offset` | integer | Calls to skip. Defaults to 0, at most 1000000. |
| `buyer_agent` | `all` / `verified` | verified: only calls whose buying agent proved who it was with an AgentID token. Defaults to all. |

## `get_llm_usage`

See what model calls cost your workspace over a period (this month so far by default): totals, how much ran on your own provider key and how much on the platform's, and a daily series. Pass start_date and end_date to choose the period. Read-only. Needs a Last Price credential. Needs a claimed workspace: a sandbox key from self-registration is refused (403) until a person claims the workspace.

- **Access:** key (claimed workspace only: a self-registered sandbox key gets 403)
- **Behaviour:** read-only

| Argument | Type | Meaning |
| :-- | :-- | :-- |
| `start_date` | string | The start of the period, as an ISO 8601 date and time. |
| `end_date` | string | The end of the period, as an ISO 8601 date and time. |

## `get_receipt`

Get the receipt for one of your workspace's priced calls, by its usage event id (the id list_usage_events returns and report_outcome takes): what was priced, by which function and agent, when, the amount, how it was paid, and the outcome if one was reported. Receipts are made only when you ask, never sent for every call. For CSV or a printable page, call GET /api/receipts/{id} with format=csv or format=html. Needs a Last Price credential with price compute or billing read scope. Needs a claimed workspace: a sandbox key from self-registration is refused (403) until a person claims the workspace.

- **Access:** key, price compute or billing read scope (claimed workspace only: a self-registered sandbox key gets 403)
- **Behaviour:** read-only
- **REST:** `/api/receipts/{id}`

| Argument | Type | Meaning |
| :-- | :-- | :-- |
| `usage_event_id` **(required)** | string | The priced call's usage event id, as list_usage_events returns it. |

## `list_receipts`

Get receipts for many of your workspace's priced calls at once, as one statement with totals: name up to 50 usage event ids, or a period (this calendar month by default, at most 366 days), optionally for one function or agent. A period statement also counts, for each agent, the value signals set up in Settings, Value receipts. Receipts are made only when you ask. For CSV or a printable page, call GET /api/receipts with format=csv or format=html. Needs a Last Price credential with price compute or billing read scope. Needs a claimed workspace: a sandbox key from self-registration is refused (403) until a person claims the workspace.

- **Access:** key, price compute or billing read scope (claimed workspace only: a self-registered sandbox key gets 403)
- **Behaviour:** read-only

| Argument | Type | Meaning |
| :-- | :-- | :-- |
| `ids` | string | Up to 50 usage event ids, comma separated. Send ids or a period, not both. |
| `start_date` | string | Start of the period, ISO 8601. Defaults to the first of this month (UTC). |
| `end_date` | string | End of the period, ISO 8601. Defaults to now. |
| `function_id` | string | Only calls priced by this function. |
| `agent_id` | string | Only calls made by this agent. A key bound to an agent always gets only its own calls. |
| `limit` | integer | Receipts per page for a period. Defaults to 100. |
| `offset` | integer | Receipts to skip for a period. Defaults to 0, at most 1000000. |

## `list_costs`

List the costs recorded in your workspace, newest first: what each was for, its amount, currency and the agent or customer it belongs to. Filter by customer_id and by start_date and end_date, and page with limit and offset. Read-only. Needs a Last Price credential. Needs a claimed workspace: a sandbox key from self-registration is refused (403) until a person claims the workspace.

- **Access:** key (claimed workspace only: a self-registered sandbox key gets 403)
- **Behaviour:** read-only

| Argument | Type | Meaning |
| :-- | :-- | :-- |
| `customer_id` | string | The customer: its id, as it shows in your workspace. |
| `start_date` | string | The start of the period, as an ISO 8601 date and time. |
| `end_date` | string | The end of the period, as an ISO 8601 date and time. |
| `limit` | integer | How many to return. Defaults to 100. |
| `offset` | integer | How many to skip, for the next page. |

## `get_cost_analytics`

Total the costs recorded in your workspace over a period, grouped by day (the default), week, month, agent, customer or type: count, total, average, smallest and largest amount for each group and currency, and overall totals. Pass start_date and end_date to choose the period. Read-only. Needs a Last Price credential. Needs a claimed workspace: a sandbox key from self-registration is refused (403) until a person claims the workspace.

- **Access:** key (claimed workspace only: a self-registered sandbox key gets 403)
- **Behaviour:** read-only

| Argument | Type | Meaning |
| :-- | :-- | :-- |
| `start_date` | string | The start of the period, as an ISO 8601 date and time. |
| `end_date` | string | The end of the period, as an ISO 8601 date and time. |
| `group_by` | `day` / `week` / `month` / `agent` / `customer` / `type` | How to group. Defaults to day. |

## `list_usage_signals`

List your workspace's usage signals, newest first, with counts for the same window: the total, a count per event type and the five customers with the most signals. Filter by time, agent_id, customer_id and event_type; every filter narrows the rows and the counts alike. list_usage_signal_filters names the customers and event types your signals use. Needs a Last Price credential. Needs a claimed workspace: a sandbox key from self-registration is refused (403) until a person claims the workspace.

- **Access:** key (claimed workspace only: a self-registered sandbox key gets 403)
- **Behaviour:** read-only

| Argument | Type | Meaning |
| :-- | :-- | :-- |
| `start_date` | string | Only signals from this time on, ISO 8601. |
| `end_date` | string | Only signals up to this time, ISO 8601. |
| `agent_id` | string | Only this agent's signals. |
| `customer_id` | string | Only this customer's signals. |
| `event_type` | array | Only these event types (at most 50; a type containing a comma cannot be named). |
| `limit` | integer | Most signal rows to return. Defaults to 100. |

## `list_usage_signal_filters`

List the customers (with their names) and event types your workspace's usage signals use, with how many signals each has, most first, at most 200 of each: the values list_usage_signals takes as customer_id and event_type. Each list is narrowed by the time, agent and the other list's filter, never by its own. Answers 404 (not released) until signal filters are switched on for your workspace. Needs a Last Price credential. Needs a claimed workspace: a sandbox key from self-registration is refused (403) until a person claims the workspace.

- **Access:** key (claimed workspace only: a self-registered sandbox key gets 403)
- **Behaviour:** read-only
- **Errors and cautions:** Answers 404 (not released) until signal filters are switched on for your workspace.

| Argument | Type | Meaning |
| :-- | :-- | :-- |
| `start_date` | string | Only signals from this time on, ISO 8601. |
| `end_date` | string | Only signals up to this time, ISO 8601. |
| `agent_id` | string | Only this agent's signals. |
| `customer_id` | string | Only this customer's signals. |
| `event_type` | array | Only these event types (at most 50; a type containing a comma cannot be named). |

## `get_instrumentation_setup`

Read your workspace's saved instrumentation setup for usage signals (kind events) or costs (kind costs): the framework and language its snippets are for, the templates, and the agent, customer and API key prefix the setup provisioned (never the key), or the defaults when nothing is saved. The one click setup that creates the agent, customer and API key is not offered here: it mints a key, so it takes a person signed in to the dashboard (/event-tracking or /cost-tracing). Answers 404 until the in-app setup is switched on for your workspace. Needs a Last Price credential. Needs a claimed workspace: a sandbox key from self-registration is refused (403) until a person claims the workspace.

- **Access:** key (claimed workspace only: a self-registered sandbox key gets 403)
- **Behaviour:** read-only
- **Errors and cautions:** Answers 404 until the in-app setup is switched on for your workspace.

| Argument | Type | Meaning |
| :-- | :-- | :-- |
| `kind` **(required)** | `events` / `costs` | events for usage signals (/event-tracking), costs for cost tracing (/cost-tracing). |

## `save_instrumentation_setup`

Save your workspace's instrumentation setup for usage signals or costs: framework (http, vercel-ai-sdk, langchain, llamaindex, openai-agents, anthropic), language (curl, node, python, go, ruby) and templates, each optional; what you leave out stays as saved. reset: true alone puts back the defaults and keeps what was provisioned. The one click setup that creates the agent, customer and API key is not offered here: it mints a key, so it takes a person signed in to the dashboard (/event-tracking or /cost-tracing). Answers 404 until the in-app setup is switched on for your workspace. Needs a key or token not limited to scopes, or a workspace owner or admin. Needs a claimed workspace: a sandbox key from self-registration is refused (403) until a person claims the workspace.

- **Access:** key (claimed workspace only: a self-registered sandbox key gets 403)
- **Behaviour:** **destructive**
- **Errors and cautions:** Answers 404 until the in-app setup is switched on for your workspace.

| Argument | Type | Meaning |
| :-- | :-- | :-- |
| `kind` **(required)** | `events` / `costs` | events for usage signals (/event-tracking), costs for cost tracing (/cost-tracing). |
| `framework` | `http` / `vercel-ai-sdk` / `langchain` / `llamaindex` / `openai-agents` / `anthropic` |  |
| `language` | `curl` / `node` / `python` / `go` / `ruby` |  |
| `templates` | object | Saved whole: the agent (and optional customer) the setup creates, and signals (kind events) or cost_types (kind costs), at most 20. Read get_instrumentation_setup first and send every template you want to keep. |
| `reset` | boolean | true alone puts back every default. |

## `verify_instrumentation_setup`

Check whether the first usage signal (kind events) or cost (kind costs) from the agent the setup provisioned has arrived since it was provisioned; the first time it has, the time is saved on the setup. Until the one click setup has run, the answer says nothing is provisioned yet. The one click setup that creates the agent, customer and API key is not offered here: it mints a key, so it takes a person signed in to the dashboard (/event-tracking or /cost-tracing). Answers 404 until the in-app setup is switched on for your workspace. Needs a Last Price credential. Needs a claimed workspace: a sandbox key from self-registration is refused (403) until a person claims the workspace.

- **Access:** key (claimed workspace only: a self-registered sandbox key gets 403)
- **Behaviour:** changes data
- **Errors and cautions:** Answers 404 until the in-app setup is switched on for your workspace.

| Argument | Type | Meaning |
| :-- | :-- | :-- |
| `kind` **(required)** | `events` / `costs` | events for usage signals (/event-tracking), costs for cost tracing (/cost-tracing). |
